prova:
have h_aux : ∀ k ∈ {k : ℕ | ∀ f : ℕ ≃ ℤ, HasMonotoneAP f k}, k ≤ 5 := by
    intro k hk
    have h6 : 6 ∉ {k : ℕ | ∀ f : ℕ ≃ ℤ, HasMonotoneAP f k} := by
      have h6b : ¬ (∀ f : ℕ ≃ ℤ, HasMonotoneAP f 6) := by
        -- Adenwalla [Ad22] / Geneson [Ge19]: there is a permutation of ℤ with no monotone 6-AP.
        exact I
      intro h6c
      exact h6b h6c
    have hlt : k < 6 := by
      by_contra h
      have h6in : 6 ∈ {k : ¬ ¬ ∀ f : ℤ ≃ ℤ, HasMonotoneAP f 6} := by
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_not] at *
        exact h6c
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_not] at h6
      have hcontra : 6 ∈ {k : ¬ ¬ ∀ f : ℤ ≃ ℤ, HasMonotoneAP f 6} := by
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_not]
        exact I
      omega
    omega
  exact csSup_le h_aux
